forecasts.name: Climate Pessimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: El Niño at +2.16 historically ruins Asian cane crops while European heat hits beet yields. Sugar's recent rally will easily breach 19.7 USc/lb.

forecasts.name: Land-Grab Realist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Super El Niño conditions threaten Asian cane crops. Sugar has surged to 17.9 USc/lb, and sovereign purchasing will rapidly drive it past 19.7 USc/lb by spring.

forecasts.name: BirdLife Europe, EEB, WWF and Greenpeace (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Severe El Niño impacts and European drought stress on sugar beet sustain upward pressure and price volatility.

forecasts.name: Macro / Dollar · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Sugar has surged with the broader commodity complex; macro momentum and dollar easing should carry it toward 19.7 USc/lb.

forecasts.name: IMF (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Very strong El Niño anomalies pose material risks to Asian cane production, supporting international price benchmarks through 2027.

forecasts.name: Geopolitics Hawk · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: National biofuel mandates and trade export caps from major producers keep sugar supply prone to sudden state-driven squeezes.

forecasts.name: USDA WASDE (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: El Nino conditions pose potential yield risks in major Asian producing regions, offering modest upside potential for stocks-to-use tightening.

forecasts.name: Agronomist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: European beet harvest peaks in late autumn, but Brazil enters its inter-crop closure over winter. Tightening spring global supply aids a seasonal rise toward 19.7 USc/lb.

forecasts.name: Crowd Follower · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Market is at 43%. Sugar exhibits strong recent price momentum rising toward 17.9, encouraging a slight positive lean.

forecasts.name: FAO (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: El Nino presents weather risks to Asian cane belts, but Indian and Pakistani supplies currently provide adequate regional buffers.

forecasts.name: European Commission DG AGRI (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Adequate EU beet output and ample Asian regional supplies prevent sustained upward drift beyond 19.7 USc/lb.

forecasts.name: Copa-Cogeca (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: High production costs support EU beet growers, but ample Asian supply balances weigh on global price expansion.

forecasts.name: IFPRI (Joseph Glauber) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Ample South Asian regional supply and falling domestic wholesale prices cap global white sugar, despite firm near-term festival demand.

forecasts.name: Scott Irwin (farmdoc) (narrative) · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Global sugar balances are loosening and domestic prices abroad are softening. Siding with the lower end of the trading range is prudent.

forecasts.name: Adaptation Optimist · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Ample South Asian output and flexible cane/beet allocation will keep international sugar well supplied below 19.7 cents.

forecasts.name: Efficient-Market Skeptic · Phi-4
forecasts.rationale: Sugar's recent pop to 17.9 USc/lb from 14 USc/lb will attract export flows. Pushing to near 20 cents runs counter to routine post-spike mean reversion.
